emergence_schedule.notes: Runtime emergence windows are engineering assumptions, not a measured dormancy schedule.

reproduction.notes: POWO describes tiny flowers/achenes; MVP preview represents delayed establishment from explicit pre-existing propagule material, then uses the generic clonal ramet engine as an engineering approximation.

body_mass.summary: No species-specific dry-mass allometry is frozen.

water_dependence.summary: Wet-tropical habitat is supported; numeric water kinetics are engineering proxies.

thermal_response.summary: Wet-tropical occurrence is supported; numeric optimum/sigma are not measured species constants.

notes: All runtime numerical coefficients are stored in data/experiments/succession-biodiversity.json and remain ASSUMED pending calibration.
The initial propagule bank is part of the conserved material ledger; no hidden spawn occurs.

leaf_length_mm.notes: POWO description reports larger leaves roughly 2-12 mm; renderer uses this only as a visual-order anchor.

render.coloration: Pale to medium green, very small leaves on freely branched succulent stems.
stage_differences: Newly emerged ramets are tiny and sparse; mature patches form fine-textured branching mats.
render.locomotion_style: Slow patch expansion through new ramets after emergence.
reference_images_asset_notes: Use accepted Pilea microphylla references; do not substitute generic Pilea imagery.

sources.citation: Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew, Plants of the World Online: Pilea microphylla (L.) Liebm.; accepted species, wet tropical biome.
Existing Simarium Pilea depressa plant-physiology coefficients used only as an engineering starting proxy.
Wet-tropical habitat direction from Kew POWO; numeric response remains assumed.
